verdict.rationale: Kling documents a REST API with JWT authentication using an AccessKey + SecretKey pair, plus MCP/CLI access for agents. Nothing in the evidence shows these credentials can be scoped, restricted to specific endpoints or permissions, or otherwise issued as least-privilege keys for an agent. Basic API key authentication is an adjacent capability, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
